newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka 1996 average annual inflation 15.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka 1996 average annual inflation 15.9 pct.

text.p: Sri Lanka's annual inflation for 1996, based on a 12-month moving average, rose to 15.9 percent from 7.7 percent in 1995, the Department of Census and Statistics said on Tuesday.
The Colombo Consumers' Price Index for December rose to 2034.2 from 2004.7 in November, an increase of 29.5 index points or 1.5 percent, it said.
Inflation in November, based on the 12-month moving average, was 15.5 percent.
The agency attributed the December increase mainly to higher prices for rice, tea dust, beef, coconuts, coconut oil and some varieties of vegetables.
